loop.hypothesis: NoSlip three-iteration postprocessing of six-dimensional tool/table contacts causes persistent tabletop creep, while gripper contacts still require the existing treatment. Fixed explicit sliding-only table pairs should retain physical pickup, Stop and release while reducing post-return creep.
loop.action_boundary: Only fixed tool/table contact dimensionality. No state freezing, sleep, welds, geometry/force-cap edits, new motion controller, language change or judge relaxation.
loop.fast_judge: actual table/grip contact dimensions and matched geometry/mass/force caps; nine existing32s retention/drop regressions
loop.strong_judge: frozen idle_placement_cases.json: nine tool/seed physical paused/resumed deliveries, returns,1800 simulated seconds idle, repick,4mm displacement bound; full application regressions and live task-bus voice/Stop journeys
loop.rollback: constructor table_contact_dim=None retains previous contacts; no live replacement until qualification passes
loop.rejected: tighter NoSlip tolerance did not improve matched idle drift; globally elliptic cone with NoSlip failed retained seed51 hammer height gate; nstep batching had no measured speed benefit
